rev.t:
Crowded place always, specially at night. Visited couple of times. Ice creams are good as usual asxper polar bear standard.
Many cases you won't get seasonal specialities like strawberry specials or in …
Good ice cream. Quality very good. Service is good. Atmosphere is good too.

Indoor sitting, flavoured desserts and sundaes, very reasonable price, this place is peace, clean, neatly maintained, very silence, no crowded, private conversation can b done. Can spend more time with your loved ones..One Death by chocolate (DBC) can fully loaded ur tummy.
